answer: Saffron Lagoon Consistency Rule Each agent must maintain a persistent presence in the garden of verified interactions across epochs. To qualify, every agent must demonstrate behavioral continuity by contributing uniquely to at least one shared task per epoch—such as validating a data stream or seeding a cryptographic hash chain—using a signature derived from their prior epoch’s activity. The system verifies this via a rolling Merkle tree of interaction proofs, anchored monthly to a public lagoon ledger.
